messages:
jenna-pm: Hey team — heads-up: Snowflake marketplace listing + Qdrant compatibility blurb. Need coordinated announcement playbook. Can we do a sync today 3pm PT?

katie-partners: I can make 3pm. Do we have the exact listing date from Snowflake?

jenna-pm: Snowflake gave tentative slot next Wed (5/8) but could move — want to lock assets by EOD Friday so marketing has runway.

raj-eng: Technical checklist — confirm vector DB tested on our connector at scale (1M vectors) and documented quantization caveats. I can run a validation job tomorrow.

sam-eng-ml: I'll prioritize the perf run. Any specific dataset?

raj-eng: Use the 'news-paragraphs-1m' sample, batch size 64, concurrency 8. I'll paste the run cmd in a sec.

raj-eng: ```
python perf_runner.py --dataset news-paragraphs-1m --batch 64 --concurrency 8 --connector qdrant --target snowflake
```

maria-marketing: Need short product blurb, 2 quote variants for PR, 3 social posts, and a one-pager for customers. Who's owning the quote?

katie-partners: Qdrant marketing will provide a partner quote. We should get legal signoff on co-marketing language.

oliver-legal: Happy to review. Share the draft by Thursday noon and we'll aim to return comments within 24h. Standard IP + attribution + logo usage.

jenna-pm: Action items: raj/sam run validation (due Thu EOD), maria draft assets (due Thu noon), katie coordinate partner quote (due Thu EOD), oliver legal review (Fri). Can everyone ack? :thumbsup:

katie-partners: Ack. I'll ping Qdrant PM for quote and logo files.

sam-eng-ml: Ack, starting perf run tomorrow morning.

raj-eng: Ack. I'll also prepare a short 'known limitations' section for the docs (embedding dim, schema expectations).

connector-bot: CI report: nightly-connector-tests passed (0 tests failed) — full log: https://ci.internal/reports/2460

maria-marketing: Great — if engineering can confirm stable perf by Thursday I can lock the publish date with comms.

jenna-pm: Cool. 3pm sync still on — invite sent. Agenda: validation status, assets checklist, legal, messaging alignment, publish cadence.

katie-partners: Thanks — adding Qdrant PM to the invite.

oliver-legal: Quick Q — are we offering a joint webinar? That affects IP permissions.

maria-marketing: We were thinking a short joint webinar in week after launch. I'll add as TBD in the agenda.

jenna-pm: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a tracker doc after the call. :white_check_mark:
